text: dsh-mnemon 是面向 DSH Web 的分层记忆系统，通过 Host、Core 和可组合的 Source/Strategy，把运行时记忆、项目档案与长期记忆空间接入每个会话。运行时记忆按回合提供，档案和记忆空间按需检索；用户可用工具、/mnemon 命令及 Web 记忆工作区查看、检索和管理内容，还可配置多个记忆 Provider 与技能管理组件。适合希望跨会话保留偏好、项目知识和可复用技能的 DSH 用户。需兼容的 DSH Host；可选 GitHub 同步需 GitHub 账号，Mnemon Native 记忆空间需本地 CLI。

dsh-mnemon adds layered memory to DSH Web: runtime memory for turns, searchable project Documents, and durable Memory Spaces. Manage memory in a Web workspace or with tools and /mnemon. Select Providers and manage reusable Skills. GitHub sync is optional; Mnemon Native uses a local CLI.

如何在网页里查看 Agent 这轮读过或写过哪些记忆？
我想把一条值得保留的回答保存到记忆里。
能不能管理 DSH 技能，并在测试后再采用改进版本？
我想通过命令查看记忆状态、召回内容或保存一条记忆。
我希望切换记忆策略或 Provider 时不必搬动已有数据。
I want my DSH agent to remember project facts between sessions.
Can I search project documents and open the relevant details only when needed?
I need durable memory spaces with selectable storage providers.
How can I review and backtest improvements to reusable DSH skills?
dsh-mnemon 的功能「分层上下文」：运行时 Source 向回合提供紧凑工作记忆，默认三层策略把项目档案和长期记忆作为按需读取来源。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「项目档案」：Agent 可搜索当前项目的托管文档，并通过文档工具创建或管理可版本化的 Markdown 档案。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「持久记忆空间」：Memory Spaces 将可选 Provider 组合为一个来源，支持按需召回和记忆管理操作。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「网页记忆工作区」：Web 客户端注册内置或侧边栏记忆视图、插件设置页及对话操作入口。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「记忆命令」：输入 /mnemon 可查看状态、召回记忆、查询关联内容、保存记忆或按 ID 忘记内容。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「技能管理」：Skills Source 注册管理能力，配合 Host 的演化流程为技能生成建议并支持测试与回测。
dsh-mnemon 的功能「记忆 Provider 组合」：Memory Spaces 明确加载配置列出的 Provider 子模块，并安装组合后的记忆来源。
dsh-mnemon 使用前须知：默认配置关闭嵌入，并将示例嵌入服务设为本机 localhost:11434；语义向量功能需另行启用和配置。

dsh-mnemon README · Why dsh-mnemon：An Agent that starts every session from scratch keeps asking what it was already told. Putting everything into one memory store is no better: it either floods each turn or misses what matters. dsh-mnemon gives DeepSeek Harness memory that is layered, visible and composable, and skills that improve with use.

dsh-mnemon README · Why dsh-mnemon：- **The right memory for each turn.** Preferences and working facts stay in context. Project documents and long-term evidence are searched only when a question needs them.
- **You can see what a turn used.** Under each reply, the turn memory bar lists the documents and memories the turn read and wrote, and one click opens each in the Memory System. The Memory System shows everything that is stored and lets you edit it.
- **Save to memory in one click.** When a conversation turns up a fact worth keeping, the brain mark under the reply hands it to a task Agent, which removes duplicates, distils it and writes it to the right Memory Space, or saves it where you choose: working memory, your profile or a Memory Space. The receipt says where it went.

dsh-mnemon README · Three kinds of memory：| Memory | Keep here | How it reaches the Agent |
|---|---|---|
| **Runtime memory** | Preferences, working agreements, facts needed on the next turn | Injected every turn as compact USER.md and MEMORY.md |
| **Project Documents** | Designs, investigations, procedures and handoffs | Searched first, then read when relevant |
| **Memory Spaces** | Durable facts, decisions, entities and their relationships | Recalled on demand from the enabled Providers |

dsh-mnemon README · Three kinds of memory：The default **Layered strategy** keeps runtime memory resident and reads the other two on demand. The **General strategy** offers every available source within one budget and lets the model decide how to use each. A **memory space** is one named, Provider-backed scope for long-term evidence; the Chinese product term is 记忆空间.

dsh-mnemon README · Skills that improve with use：**Skills** is an experimental component for the `SKILL.md` skills DSH loads from your project and your home folder. Its page sits in the Memory System, or in the sidebar on its own.

dsh-mnemon README · Skills that improve with use：- **Manage.** Switch a skill off for the model or the `/` menu, use it in the conversation in one click, edit it, and go back to any earlier version.
- **Evolve.** With self-evolution on, finished conversations are reviewed in the background for corrections, "from now on" instructions, failed tools and reusable procedures. A suggestion cites the steps it rests on; a task Agent drafts the new `SKILL.md`, which is backtested against the current version before you adopt it. Nothing changes without your **Adopt**.
- **Test.** Each skill has its own cases, from reviews, from recorded conversations or written by hand, and a backtest scores any version on them.
- **Install.** The market searches skills.sh's open index and reads any GitHub repository, any site publishing an Agent Skills discovery index, and curated catalogs; every install is previewed, with security reviews where they exist.
- **In the conversation.** A line under each turn names the skills it used and what its review suggested, each one click from its page.

dsh-mnemon README · Skills that improve with use：Self-evolution stays off until you turn it on under **Plugins → dsh-mnemon → Skills**. The [Skills guide](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/guides/skills.md) walks through every screen.

dsh-mnemon README · Quick start：1. In the page that opens, click **Plugins → Add plugin**, type `dsh-mnemon`, click **Install**, then **Enable now**.
2. Open **Memory System** in the sidebar. **Status** shows each memory component and Provider.
3. Tell a conversation something to remember. The turn memory bar under the reply lists what the turn read and wrote, and the brain mark saves a reply to memory.
4. For Memory Spaces, install the Mnemon CLI for Mnemon Native with `npm install --global @mnemon-dev/mnemon`, or enable another Provider on the Memory Spaces page.
5. Choose the main strategy and enhancements under **Plugins → dsh-mnemon**.

dsh-mnemon README · Quick start：dsh-mnemon supports published DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and retains support for the `0.2.1` RC line and `0.2.0-rc.2`. RC1 requires Node.js >=24.9.0; older Hosts follow their own Node.js requirements. The same package serves the desktop app's Plugins page, `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon` on the command line, and Headless with `dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-mnemon`; older hosts keep the release [compatibility and upgrades](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/reference/compatibility.md) names for them. [Getting started](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/guides/getting-started.md) continues from here, and [compatibility and upgrades](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/reference/compatibility.md) covers existing installations.

dsh-mnemon README · How it works：- **Sources** own memory and its operations: Runtime memory, Project Documents and Memory Spaces, whose Providers are its children.
- A **Strategy** decides how the available Sources take part in a turn: what stays resident, what can be searched, and which tools and budgets apply. Enhancements add to it through standard slots.
- **Core** validates the result into one immutable **View** for the turn. The DSH Host pins it to that turn and controls tool access.

dsh-mnemon README · How it works：The same public contracts serve the shipped plugins and external repositories. [Architecture](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/development/architecture.md) explains ownership, the turn lifecycle and the UI regions components contribute to.
dsh-mnemon README · Official plugins：The Starter pins a tested combination of independently versioned packages. One main strategy runs at a time; the enhancements are off until you turn them on.

dsh-mnemon README · Build your own：Define a Source or Strategy with `dsh-mnemon/extension-sdk`, add an enhancement through the standard slots, or write a Memory Spaces driver with `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces/provider-sdk`. A component can also add its own settings and Status card to the pages dsh-mnemon shows. Your repository owns its manifest, dependencies, tests and build; DSH installs and mounts it, and choosing it as the main strategy is a separate decision.

dsh-mnemon README · Data and trust：- Runtime memory and Project Documents are local files; Mnemon Native is local. Third-party Providers use their own services and scopes.
- Turning a component off does not erase its memory, and changing the storage location does not move data. Use ZIP backup to carry it.
- Skills keeps its evolution data (suggestions, test cases and the conversations reviews read, with secrets redacted) in the local storage root, outside backups. An Agent follows a skill from the market as written, so preview it before installing.
- Git sync publishes the same Mnemon Pack payload as readable files to a repository you own, so another machine can pull it, with **Sync now**, **Check remote** before anything is written, or **Automatic sync**. When two machines wrote one subject differently, both wordings stay until you accept and apply a **Memory reconciliation** plan; see [Git repository sync](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/en/guides/operations.md#git-repository-sync).
- Saved Provider credentials stay on the Host and are never exported. Backups still contain private memory; protect them.
- Sources and Strategies are trusted in-process JavaScr

dsh-mnemon README · 为什么需要 dsh-mnemon：每次会话都从零开始的 Agent，会反复询问你早已说过的事情；把所有内容塞进同一个记忆库也不行，要么每轮都被淹没，要么漏掉真正要紧的信息。dsh-mnemon 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层、可见、可组合的记忆，以及越用越好的技能。

dsh-mnemon README · 为什么需要 dsh-mnemon：- **每一轮都拿到合适的记忆。** 偏好和工作中的事实常驻上下文；项目档案与长期证据只在问题需要时才检索。
- **看得见这一轮用了什么。** 每条回复下方的回合记忆栏列出这一轮读到和写入的档案与记忆，点一下就在记忆系统中打开它；记忆系统展示全部已保存的内容，并可直接编辑。
- **一键存入记忆。** 对话里出现值得保留的事实，点击回复下的脑形图标，由任务 Agent 去重、提炼并写入合适的记忆空间，也可以直接存到你选择的位置：工作记忆、用户画像或某个记忆空间。回执写明存到了哪里。
- **越用越好的技能。** 技能管理把 DSH 的技能集中到一处：它能复盘你的真实对话，写出更好的 `SKILL.md`，先回测再交给你采纳；还能从 skills.sh、GitHub 和发布 Agent Skills 的网站安装更多技能。
- **在插件页组合。** 选择一个主策略和若干可选增强，切换时无需迁移任何数据；每个组件都有自己的设置页。
- **数据放在你想放的地方。** 默认由 Mnemon Native 在本地保存，也可以接入八种第三方 Provider；存储范围可选全局、按工作区、集中存储或你指定的目录，并支持 ZIP 备份。
- **可以扩展。** Source 与 Strategy 都是基于公开 SDK 的普通 DSH 插件；安装的组件与随附组件拥有同样的页面和开关。

dsh-mnemon README · 三类记忆：| 记忆 | 适合保存 | 如何进入 Agent 上下文 |
|---|---|---|
| **运行时记忆** | 偏好、协作约定、下一轮就需要的事实 | 每轮以紧凑的 USER.md 与 MEMORY.md 注入 |
| **项目档案** | 设计、调查、流程与交接材料 | 先检索，相关时再阅读全文 |
| **记忆空间** | 长期事实、决策、实体及其关系 | 按需从已启用的 Provider 召回 |

默认的**分层策略**让运行时记忆常驻，另外两类按需读取；**通用策略**在同一份预算内提供全部可用来源，由模型决定如何使用。**记忆空间**是由 Provider 承载、可以独立命名和激活的长期证据范围，英文界面称 memory space。

dsh-mnemon README · 越用越好的技能：**技能管理**是一个实验性组件，用来管理 DSH 从项目和用户目录加载的 `SKILL.md` 技能。它的页面在记忆系统里，也可以作为独立的侧边栏入口。

| 回合复盘提出改进 | 回测之后由你采纳 |
|---|---|
| [](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/guides/skills.md#对话中) | [](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/guides/skills.md#进化) |

dsh-mnemon README · 越用越好的技能：- **管理。** 让技能不被模型加载或不出现在 `/` 菜单里，一键在对话中使用，直接编辑，并能回到任意历史版本。
- **进化。** 开启自进化后，对话结束会在后台复盘，寻找多次纠正、“以后都这样做”的指示、工具失败和可复用的流程。每条建议都标出所依据的步骤；任务 Agent 写出新的 `SKILL.md`，先与当前版本回测对比，再由你采纳。没有你的**采纳**，什么都不会改。
- **测试。** 每个技能都有自己的用例，来自复盘、记录的对话或手写，任意版本都能在这些用例上回测打分。
- **安装。** 市场可以搜索 skills.sh 的开放索引，读取任意 GitHub 仓库、任何按 Agent Skills 发现协议发布技能的网站，以及技能目录；每次安装前都能预览，有安全审核的会一并显示。
- **对话中。** 每个回合下方的一行列出这一回合用到的技能和复盘提出的建议，点一下就能打开。

dsh-mnemon README · 工作原理：[](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/development/architecture.md)

- **Source（记忆来源）** 拥有记忆及其操作：运行时记忆、项目档案和记忆空间，Provider 是记忆空间的子模块。
- **Strategy（策略）** 决定可用的 Source 如何参与一轮对话：哪些常驻、哪些可以检索、使用哪些工具和预算。增强通过标准插槽为它补充能力。
- **Core（核心）** 把结果校验为本轮唯一的不可变 **View（上下文视图）**，DSH 宿主将它固定到这一轮并控制工具访问。

随附插件与外部仓库使用同一套公开契约。[架构](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/development/architecture.md)说明了归属关系、回合生命周期，以及组件可以贡献内容的界面区域。

dsh-mnemon README · 数据与信任：- 运行时记忆与项目档案是本地文件，Mnemon Native 也在本地；第三方 Provider 使用各自的服务与作用域。
- 关闭组件不会删除其中的记忆，更换存储位置也不会搬移数据；需要迁移时使用 ZIP 备份。
- 技能管理的进化数据（建议、测试用例以及复盘读过的对话，机密已替换）保存在本地存储根目录，不在备份之内。来自市场的技能会被 Agent 按原文执行，安装前请先预览。
- Git 同步把同一份 Mnemon Pack 载荷以可读文件发布到你自己的仓库，另一台机器可以拉取；可以**立即同步**、在写入前**检查远端**，或按间隔**自动同步**。两台设备对同一主题写法不同时，两种写法都会保留，直到你接受并执行**记忆整理**给出的方案，见 [Git 仓库同步](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/main/docs/zh-CN/guides/operations.md#git-仓库同步)。
- 已保存的 Provider 凭据只留在宿主上，不会被导出；但备份仍包含私有记忆，请妥善保护。
- Source 与 Strategy 是受信任的进程内 JavaScript，**不是沙箱代码**；历史记忆永远不会凌驾于当前指令之上。
